population: B2B clean-train folds0-3 (1421 queries); fold4=611, B2B581, internal300, development and confirmation sealed
primary_reason: Depth10 is the previously frozen C0 high-quality control and the A2 primary baseline; changing the primary after seeing A2 would add design freedom. Other schedules are prespecified sensitivity checks.
edit_family: STAY plus 76 unique permutations at Kendall inversion distance at most two from the frozen V8 order; signatures are relative V8 positions, not packet IDs
strict_beneficial: No previously successful attainable anchor breaks, per-query cumulative tokens <= V8, and either at least one anchor repair or strictly lower cumulative tokens
tradeoff: A quality repair with higher cumulative tokens, or a quality break with lower cumulative tokens, is incomparable under the strict Pareto label and remains unlabeled for pairwise training
audit: Per-query strict-beneficial edit count, distinct stop-mask outcome count, structural edit-signature frequency/entropy, schedule overlap/Jaccard, and benefit type (0.90 repair, Complete repair, token-only, repair plus saving)
interpretation: Labels are derived from exact cached Target outcomes solely for train-side design; none is a deployment feature. This audit cannot demonstrate cross-query learnability.
